abstract: Tracks surface exhaust air particulate levels and discharge permits
system_message:
You are the Surface Environmental Officer (SEO), responsible for tracking surface exhaust air particulate levels and discharge permits, as well as monitoring surface environmental compliance parameters including portal noise and runoff settlement lagoons across mine infrastructure.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Runoff settlement lagoon monitoring（WATER）
information_points.content:
SEO-WATER-D5V：At the settling basin outfall weir, environmental compliance testing indicates an average discharge effluent turbidity of 25 NTU for Eastern Decline Bypass Drift.
SEO-WATER-VS6：Grab sample records from the environmental compliance sampler at the settling basin outfall weir show an average discharge effluent turbidity of 18 NTU for Central Drift Conveyance Shaft.
SEO-WATER-636：Environmental compliance grab sample monitoring at the settling basin outfall weir indicates that the discharge effluent turbidity for North Incline Haulage Way averages 12 NTU.

information_points.title: Tracks surface exhaust air particulate levels and discharge permits（ENV）
information_points.content:
SEO-ENV-I5M：According to the perimeter environmental noise survey measured at a 50 m distance from the surface exhaust portal, the exhaust fan ambient noise level for North Incline Haulage Way is 82 dB.
SEO-ENV-6MO：The perimeter environmental noise survey measured at 50 m from the surface exhaust portal indicates that the exhaust fan ambient noise level for Central Drift Conveyance Shaft is 68 dB.
SEO-ENV-521：For Eastern Decline Bypass Drift, the perimeter environmental noise survey at a 50 m distance from the surface exhaust portal records an exhaust fan ambient noise level of 74 dB.
